title: Proverbs 12: Whoso Loveth Instruction Loveth Knowledge
body:
Read the chapter → [Proverbs 12](/bible/proverbs/12)

**[Proverbs 12:1-14](/bible/proverbs/12#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/proverbs/12#v1)</sup> Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/proverbs/12#v2)</sup> A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/proverbs/12#v3)</sup> A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/proverbs/12#v4)</sup> A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/proverbs/12#v5)</sup> The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/proverbs/12#v6)</sup> The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/proverbs/12#v7)</sup> The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/proverbs/12#v8)</sup> A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/proverbs/12#v9)</sup> He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/proverbs/12#v10)</sup> A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/proverbs/12#v11)</sup> He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/proverbs/12#v12)</sup> The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/proverbs/12#v13)</sup> The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/proverbs/12#v14)</sup> A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

**[Proverbs 12:15-28](/bible/proverbs/12#v15)**

> <sup>[15](/bible/proverbs/12#v15)</sup> The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/proverbs/12#v16)</sup> A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/proverbs/12#v17)</sup> He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/proverbs/12#v18)</sup> There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/proverbs/12#v19)</sup> The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/proverbs/12#v20)</sup> Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/proverbs/12#v21)</sup> There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/proverbs/12#v22)</sup> Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/proverbs/12#v23)</sup> A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/proverbs/12#v24)</sup> The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
>
> <sup>[25](/bible/proverbs/12#v25)</sup> Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
>
> <sup>[26](/bible/proverbs/12#v26)</sup> The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
>
> <sup>[27](/bible/proverbs/12#v27)</sup> The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
>
> <sup>[28](/bible/proverbs/12#v28)</sup> In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
